title: Open Source Contribution Policy
description: All software produced by the Foundation is open-source under OSI-approved licenses. Contribution guidelines follow standard fork-and-PR workflow.

sections.heading: Licensing
sections.body: Default license is MIT for libraries, AGPL for platform infrastructure. All third-party dependencies must be OSI-approved.

sections.heading: Contributions
sections.body: External contributors must sign a Developer Certificate of Origin. Maintainers review all contributions.
